data.title: CAPEX - As-Is process map (as documented in the CAPEX SOPs and the process register v5, Oct 2026)
data.chainlabel: Approved projects are spent against the WBSE and settled to AUC monthly; capitalised assets and intangibles join the monthly depreciation run; impairments, retirements and the physical verification keep the register current; leases run in CoStar and post to SAP through BlackLine; everything lands in the FA and lease month-end reporting to R2R
data.asisnote: As documented in the CAPEX SOPs (8.3.3.x, 8.4.x) and the process register v5 (Oct 2026). LT review Oct 2026 applied: four steps re-tagged Semi-automated (green); activities previously tagged Controlling are shown as Local Finance. Updated for the CAPEX feedback (Pek Sian Ong, Oct 2026): Intangible Assets and the CN group vs local balance file removed; month-end reports, settlement runs, the depreciation error resolution (Capper Bot) and the physical asset verification marked semi-automated; the CoStar to BlackLine journal entries marked automated

tpis.act: Row counts and control totals checked against SAP on each refresh. This is what would make Snowflake trusted.

tpis.touch: Control totals against SAP on each load - supports the reconciliations

tpis.t: Incremental loading and pre-aggregation for scale
tpis.act: About 300,000 rows for June alone. Incremental refresh keeps performance stable as full history is loaded.
tpis.xc: No
tpis.touch: Dashboard performance

tpis.t: Anomaly detection on asset movements
tpis.act: Flag unusual additions, disposals, transfers and impairments month on month before anyone reads the dashboard.
tpis.xc: Yes — R2R, Controlling: Anomaly detection on asset movements.
tpis.touch: Unusual additions, disposals, transfers and impairments flagged before review

tpis.t: Automated month-on-month variance commentary
tpis.act: Generate a first-draft explanation of movements for the FA team to review, rather than writing it each cycle.
tpis.xc: No
tpis.touch: First-draft variance commentary for the depreciation variance analysis

tpis.t: Depreciation forecast view from AR03 simulation data
tpis.act: AR03 depreciation simulation is already identified as a needed extract. Surfacing forward depreciation answers the end-of-life question raised in session.
tpis.xc: Yes — R2R, Controlling: Depreciation forecast view from AR03 simulation data.
tpis.touch: Forward depreciation from the AR03 simulation

tpis.t: Ground the assistant on a governed semantic model
tpis.act: A retrieval-based assistant over a defined semantic layer avoids both the Copilot context problem and external-model privacy exposure.
tpis.xc: Yes — R2R, Global Digital: Ground the assistant on a governed semantic model.
tpis.touch: Assistant over a governed semantic layer

tpis.t: Retire the annual Operations request entirely
tpis.act: Once the pilot proves out, generate the Operations pack from the dashboard rather than servicing the request each year.
tpis.xc: Yes — R2R, Global Operations: Retire the annual Operations request entirely.
tpis.touch: Annual Operations pack generated from the dashboard

tpis.t: Collaborate with the GPO team building a similar dashboard
tpis.act: The GPO is developing a comparable higher-level dashboard sourced from Snowflake. Overlap is known and acknowledged.
tpis.xc: Yes — GPO, R2R: Collaborate with the GPO team building a similar dashboard.
tpis.touch: Overlap with the GPO dashboard

tpis.t: Analyse what already exists in Snowflake before building further
tpis.act: A Financial Analytics Council global fixed asset dashboard already provides depreciation and management information.
tpis.xc: Yes — R2R, Global Digital, GPO: Analyse what already exists in Snowflake before building further.
tpis.touch: Existing Snowflake FA dashboard

tpis.t: Work with GPO and GPDD to ingest the remaining tables into Snowflake
tpis.act: Get the outstanding tables onto the platform so the strategic route becomes viable.
tpis.xc: Yes — GPO, GPDD, R2R: Work with GPO and GPDD to ingest the remaining tables into Snowflake.
tpis.touch: Remaining tables into Snowflake

tpis.t: Leverage the FC&CG SAP reporting automation framework
tpis.act: Rather than building a separate extraction, use the framework FC&CG already offers. Already engaged.
tpis.xc: Yes — FC&CG, R2R: Leverage the FC&CG SAP reporting automation framework.
tpis.touch: FC&CG SAP reporting automation framework

tpis.t: Add a country-level view alongside management unit
tpis.act: Markets need to answer how much capital was invested in their country. Supports government and agency engagement.
tpis.xc: Yes — R2R, LT, market finance: Add a country-level view alongside management unit.
tpis.touch: Country-level capital invested view

tpis.t: Consider an entity view in place of management unit
tpis.act: Management unit requires a mapping against DRM data that must be refreshed. An entity view removes one mapping dependency.
tpis.xc: Yes — Controlling, R2R: Consider an entity view in place of management unit.
tpis.touch: Entity view instead of management unit

tpis.t: Consider a budget versus capitalised actual view
tpis.act: Controlling reviews budget against market requests, and some markets maintain budget in SAP.
tpis.xc: Yes — Controlling, R2R: Consider a budget versus capitalised actual view.
tpis.touch: Budget vs capitalised actual - month-end project reports and closure review

tpis.t: Add an asset useful-life and end-of-depreciation view
tpis.act: Not all assets share the same life. Leadership asked for visibility of when depreciation ends.
tpis.xc: Yes — R2R, Controlling: Add an asset useful-life and end-of-depreciation view.
tpis.touch: Useful life and end of depreciation per asset

tpis.t: Run a joint design workstream before finalising the pages
tpis.act: Agreed in session: a short workstream with Controlling and leadership to decide what else the dashboard should carry.
tpis.xc: Yes — R2R, Controlling, LT: Run a joint design workstream before finalising the pages.
tpis.touch: Joint design workstream before the pages are fixed

tpis.t: Check whether Global Ops has already built a CapEx utilisation dashboard
tpis.act: Utilisation against approved CapEx may already exist. Give them the idea rather than rebuilding it.
tpis.xc: Yes — Global Operations, R2R: Check whether Global Ops has already built a CapEx utilisation dashboard.
tpis.touch: CapEx utilisation against approved CapEx

tpis.t: Publish one Snowflake ingestion roadmap across the August projects
tpis.act: Fixed assets, BSR automation and non-PO accrual are all waiting on the same platform. One roadmap serves all three.
tpis.xc: Yes — Global Digital, R2R, P2P: Publish one Snowflake ingestion roadmap across the August projects.
tpis.touch: Snowflake ingestion roadmap

tpis.t: Take one enterprise AI decision for finance dashboards
tpis.act: Copilot has now been tested independently by more than one team. One decision, published, stops the repetition.
tpis.xc: Yes — Global Digital, all towers: Take one enterprise AI decision for finance dashboards.
tpis.touch: Enterprise AI decision for finance dashboards

tpis.t: Offer the FC&CG extraction service to other towers
tpis.act: The same scheduled SAP extraction pattern serves R2R, P2P and Controlling. Build it once as a shared service.
tpis.xc: Yes — FC&CG, R2R, P2P, Controlling: Offer the FC&CG extraction service to other towers.
tpis.touch: Extraction service shared with other towers

tpis.t: Agree a common asset reporting framework with Controlling and local finance
tpis.act: Standardise the reporting view before the pages are fixed, so the dashboard is not redesigned after launch.
tpis.xc: Yes — R2R, Controlling, local finance: Agree a common asset reporting framework with Controlling and local finance.
tpis.touch: Common asset reporting framework with Local Finance

tpis.t: Set a central data-privacy position on external AI models
tpis.act: The privacy question that blocks better models is not a project decision. It needs an owned, published position.
tpis.xc: Yes — Global Digital, Legal, Controllership: Set a central data-privacy position on external AI models.
tpis.touch: Data-privacy position on external AI models

tpis.t: Define a shared semantic layer standard for finance dashboards
tpis.act: An AI assistant only works on a standardised semantic layer. Setting the standard once makes every tower's dashboard AI-ready.
tpis.xc: Yes — Global Digital, all towers: Define a shared semantic layer standard for finance dashboards.
tpis.touch: Semantic layer standard
